definitions.gloss: to be completed, to be finished, to be ready
definitions.explanation: For something to reach a state of completion. Used for food being cooked, work being done, products being manufactured, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出来上|できあ}がった。
⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{出来上|できあ}がった。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出来上|できあ}がる⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、あと⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: I hear it will take another six months until the new building is completed.

notes:
{出来上|できあ}がる is the intransitive counterpart of ⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧. It focuses on the result — the state of being complete.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)
- No direct object; the completed thing is the subject

ASPECT (ている):
- {出来上|できあ}がって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: is already completed/finished (resultant state)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出来上|できあ}がる (the food is ready)
- ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出来上|できあ}がる (a work is completed)
- ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出来上|できあ}がる (to turn out beautifully)
- ⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧{出来上|できあ}がる (to turn out well)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{完成|かんせい}する→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧: to be completed (more formal, for projects/works)
- {出来上|できあ}がる: to be finished (broader use, including cooking)
